notes.title: 🧟‍♂️ Day Zero Demo is Now Available
notes.content:
[b]🧟‍♂️ Day Zero Demo is Now Available – Experience the Zombie Apocalypse Firsthand! 🧟‍♂️[/b]

Survivors, the time has come! The Day Zero Demo is now live as part of Steam Next Fest, giving you an exclusive first look at the ultimate zombie survival experience. The apocalypse is unfolding, and every decision you make will shape your fate. Do you have what it takes to survive?

[b]🔥 What is Day Zero?[/b]
Day Zero is a text-based, narrative-driven zombie survival game where your choices determine your fate. Set in a realistic, collapsing world, you must navigate a harsh, unforgiving environment, scavenge for resources, and make life-altering moral decisions.

[b]🎮 What’s Included in the Demo?[/b]
The Day Zero Demo offers a rich, branching narrative experience, allowing you to explore multiple survival paths. 

Here's what you can expect: 

✅ Multiple Story Paths – Experience different narratives based on your choices. 

✅ Immersive Text-Based Survival – Feel the tension of the zombie apocalypse through gripping storytelling. 

✅ Moral Dilemmas & Difficult Decisions – Who will you trust? What will you sacrifice? 

✅ Scavenging, Strategy, & Survival – Every resource counts. Make your choices wisely!

[b]🏆 Why Play the Demo?[/b]
As part of Steam Next Fest, the Day Zero Demo allows you to get an early taste of the game’s gripping survival mechanics and explore the vast number of choices that make every playthrough unique.

[b]🛠️ Your Feedback Shapes the Game![/b]
We want to create the best possible zombie survival experience, and your input is invaluable. 

After playing, let us know: 

🔹 What choices felt the most impactful? 

🔹 How was your survival experience? 

🔹 Any features you'd love to see?
Join the Steam discussions or our Discord to share your feedback, discuss strategies, and connect with other survivors.

[b]🛒 Add Day Zero to Your Wishlist![/b]
If you enjoy the Day Zero Demo, make sure to add the full game to your Steam Wishlist! This helps us tremendously and ensures you won’t miss any updates or the official launch.

[b]👉 Download the Day Zero Demo now on Steam![/b]
The world is ending, and survival is in your hands. Are you ready to face the zombie apocalypse? Let us know how long you last! 🚨🔥
